mapper.select: SELECT * FROM employees ORDER BY employee_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employees(employee_id,first_name, last_name, email, phone_number, hire_date, job_id, salary, commission_pct, manager_id, department_id) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{firstName},#{lastName},#{email},#{phoneNumber},#{hireDate},#{jobId},#{salary},#{commissionPct},#{managerId},#{departmentId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE (first_name LIKE '%${firstName}%') OR (last_name LIKE '%${lastName}%')
